title: Futures book improvement programme (target: estimated live Sharpe 1.5+)

rules.equity_beta: allowed. A candidate that adds equity exposure may enter when it improves the book. Safeguard: the book may not get worse in 2010-17 or 2018-22 (2018-22 contains the 2022 bear market), so a pure bull-market bet fails; the ES/NQ beta share is reported for every candidate.
rules.evidence: backtest on 2010-22 (entry) and 2023-26 (judge), strict rule (+0.05 on 2023-26, no earlier period lower); then paper from 2026-10-01 (unseen). One month of paper says little; paper keeps running and is evaluated over months.
rules.no_stop: we keep working until the estimated live Sharpe is good enough for regular payouts. Instead of a stop rule a SWITCH rule: each data source gets a small pre-registered set of tests; when it is used up we move to a new source (new information), never back to re-tuning a tested idea after seeing its result.
rules.honesty: every test is pre-registered and counted; the planning Sharpe (after the luck haircut for all futures trials) is reported after every round; nothing changes the paper book without the user's OK.

sources.source: EIA weekly petroleum stocks (crude ex SPR, gasoline, distillate) and natural-gas storage
intraday 1-minute (ES, NQ, GC, CL owned; more via Databento after a cost quote)
